title: Generated-footage shot specs
description: One file per cut: motion/shots/shots.json. Each shot is one generated clip for a frame of STORYBOARD.md with medium generated or mixed. No visible UI, screens, readable text or logos inside a shot: screens are composited later from real UI recordings. Paths are relative to motion/shots/.

cut.description: Cut name from narrative.md, e.g. film-60.

characters.description: Character and continuity sheets, e.g. characters/site-manager.md.

frame.description: Frame number N of '## Frame N' in STORYBOARD.md.

subject.description: Who or what, with the character anchor.

action.description: One movement the model can do well.

camera.description: Shot size, lens, angle, move (or locked off).

light.description: The scene light line, then where it falls in this shot.

duration_s.description: Length used in the edit; generate about 1 s longer.

prompt.description: The full prompt sent to the provider. Positive description only.

negative.description: Negative prompt, only if the provider takes one. The one place where text, logo, screen may be named.

fallback.description: What replaces the shot after max_takes failures.
